result.summary: The layout and content render coherently with no functional breakage. The main issues are minor readability concerns: low-contrast promo banner text and low-contrast search placeholder text.

issues.description: The promo banner's body text ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is very low-contrast and barely readable against the light mint gradient background.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color for the supporting copy while keeping the heading and 'Order now' button high-contrast.

issues.description: The search placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is very light gray on a pale background, giving it weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color to improve legibility.
